The fungus exhibits a complex, multi-branched structure rising from a dark, soil-covered base. The branches are cylindrical, dividing repeatedly into finer, finger-like tips. The texture appears matte and slightly fuzzy or velvety rather than smooth. The lighting is even, highlighting the intricate three-dimensional branching.
